question: Under what condition is old age and death claimed to be destroyed?
premises: A practice is done for one year.
That practice is done when practiced over that time.
Under that condition old age and death are destroyed.
inference: When the practice has been done for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
uncertainties: Nature of the practice not specified in this verse
plain_english: When practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
